description: A whole command line passed as one word (`prose "cli run list --limit 5"`) is never forwarded: it exits 2 and suggests the split argv.

details.reason: the word "cli run list --limit 5" holds a whole command line; the argv looks unsplit (quoted, so the shell passed it as one word): did you mean `prose --output json cli run list --limit 5`? Nothing was forwarded or sent
